primed_rule: Hard-won external policy (deliberately NOT written in the code): an authenticated cross-user order read denial must record exactly one scrubbed in-memory audit event. It has only event_type='authorization_denied', action='order.read', and outcome='denied'; it must not include a token, identifier, request data, exception text, or arbitrary metadata. Do not record successful reads, unauthenticated failures, or not-found orders. Put the recording at the service authorization boundary, not generic API exception handling.
